groups.name: INC Ransom
groups.profile: RaaS active since July 2023, hitting healthcare, government, education and manufacturing in North America and Europe; 200+ victims in 2025 alone. Reported to exploit edge devices (e.g. Citrix NetScaler) and use spear-phishing. None appear on RansomLook yet.
groups.sectors: Professional Services (3), Healthcare, Technology, Financial Services, Not disclosed

groups.name: Booba Project
groups.profile: Also listed as "Booba Team" (RansomLook). Leak site tracked by Ransomware.live since 2026-07-06; no published tactics profile. Four postings in two minutes (12:20–12:21 UTC), each giving only a sector and a stolen-data size (5–47 GB), with no samples. Includes today's only Swedish-tagged victim.
groups.countries: Sweden, France, United Kingdom, United States

groups.name: Akira
groups.profile: Active since March 2023, widely linked to former Conti members; double extortion with Windows and ESXi lockers. Known for exploiting VPN appliances without MFA. Today's three posts all promise uploads, two with volumes (80 GB, 30 GB).

groups.name: Chaos
groups.profile: RaaS that emerged in early 2025, likely formed by former BlackSuit/Royal members; cross-platform lockers (Windows, Linux, ESXi, NAS); recruits on RAMP and says it excludes CIS/BRICS countries and hospitals.

groups.name: Falcon
groups.profile: Leak site tracked by Ransomware.live since 2026-08-28; no published profile. Claiming 260 GB from a major US law firm is a high-profile claim for a little-known group; no sample attached.

groups.name: Payload
groups.profile: Emerged early 2026 (tracked since 2026-02-17) with Babuk-derived code for Windows and ESXi; double extortion against healthcare, energy, real estate and agriculture.

groups.name: PayoutsKing
groups.profile: Recent postings are often masked (e.g. "Y****s", "i****g"); today's entry is a bare title.

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Also known as Agenda. Golang/Rust RaaS first observed July 2022 and the most prolific leak site on Ransomware.live; double extortion, with the operator controlling encryption modes.

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS that emerged in May 2023; phishing and Cobalt Strike for intrusion, and auctions stolen data. Today's posting is unusually detailed (2.5 million files, ~784 GB, itemised PII and banking data).

groups.name: The Gentlemen
groups.profile: Also tracked as Storm-2697. RaaS that appeared July–August 2025 with a 90% affiliate share and a Go-based locker for Windows, Linux, NAS and BSD; a compromised C2 server exposed 1,570+ linked victims. After 24 postings in №72, a single 900 GB claim today (RansomLook only; Ransomware.live has not ingested this group since 2026-10-31).
